notes: Official Registre Central du Commerce (OMPIC). directinfo.ma free basic search is Google reCAPTCHA-gated; detailed company profiles, Bilans (financial statements), statistics, and the OMPIC API (CAPI) are paid/subscription. www.ompic.ma timed out. No open bulk/API. Identifiers: ICE (15-digit unified), RC (per-court), IF (tax). Dirigeants/associés = personal data (Law 09-08). Field model from public knowledge; no values copied.

Working CKAN open-data portal + JSON API. But NO company register — searches for entreprise/registre commerce/ompic/societe returned only statistics (Bank Al-Maghrib, CNSS, ANRT) and unrelated datasets. Useful for economic/sector statistics, not company-level identity.
